purpose: Short safe finite paths for broad desktop inspection, reconciled against C nested inventory. These are source-backed entry instructions, not completed verification.
globalRules: Use existing records and both 1440/1133 widths where meaningful.
Open/read/local draft/cancel only; no Send, Approve, Save, Invite, Pay, destructive confirm, upload or sample creation.
Some apparently editing openers mutate immediately: Shoot Add shot, Accept suggestion, Add manually, captured/asked toggles; People Remove access/Resend/Restore; do not invoke.
Invoice Approve invoice immediately saves approval before showing optional forwarding. Reach Forward through an already Approved invoice only.
Team Staff Assign with dirty hours saves before confirmation; do not invoke that branch.
N073/N074 older Shoot access/existing-plan branches may lack openers; classify conditional/unreachable from actual live entry rather than forcing state.
No-result search and local selection are reversible; restore original queries, filters, role/navigation and storage where practical.

Correction from lead source review: Storyboard selectImageSource library and stock commands immediately mutate a frame. They are not safe picker-form openers. Native Add link prompt was not exposed by the inspection; no URL was added. Source-menu command labels only are verified.

paths.entry: Open versions
paths.actions: Open; inspect V labels and current/read-only metadata; press Escape, then reopen and outside-click. Do not choose New blank version, Duplicate current version or Rename.
paths.expected: Panel dismisses appropriately and focus returns to opener. Source predicts Escape gap; capture before/after.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: Adjust project flow
paths.actions: Open named icon; inspect document.activeElement; Tab/Shift+Tab; press Escape. Reopen only if needed, then Close. Do not drag, Hide, Reset or change Edit/Animation.
paths.expected: Focus enters visible panel, background respects chosen modality, Escape closes and focus returns. Source predicts gap.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: existing time block
paths.actions: Tab through project rail and a time block; Enter existing block; inspect Stage/Hours/Note editor and absence/presence of Add/date/Done alternatives; Cancel. Do not Save/Delete/drag/resize.
paths.expected: Finite keyboard route supports creation and completion; editor dismissal/focus is visible. Record untested mutations and source-only cross-day risk.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: Review invoice / invoice row
paths.actions: Open a Submitted invoice, preferably with rate/currency mismatch; inspect agreed versus invoice amounts and required Approval note. Open View PDF then Back to invoice. Open Send back; observe blank reason disables Send back; enter a temporary reason, then Back/Cancel.
paths.expected: Mismatch clearly disclosed; required note/reason validation works; PDF context and modal focus survive nested paths.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: Manage invoice > Forward invoice on an ALREADY Approved invoice
paths.actions: Use only an existing Approved invoice; open Forward invoice and its multi-selector; inspect destinations/Clear; Done. Never click Approve invoice merely to reach Forward.
paths.expected: No destinations means Email invoice disabled; chosen draft destinations are explicit; Done closes without emailing.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: Invite person / Invite freelancer / Invite Client
paths.actions: Open with current view defaults; inspect roles and blank-email Next disabled. Enter a valid existing mock address only as a draft; Next; inspect access summary, selected Client/projects and project search/no results; Back/Cancel or Escape. Never Send invite.
paths.expected: Role preselection matches directory view; invitation/access scope legible, required selections explain disabled Send; keyboard focus and cancellation retain no record.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: Sarah Chen Capacity / workload button

paths.entry: Change project access
paths.actions: Open Jess contact access editor; inspect existing checked projects; optionally uncheck/recheck one draft only; Cancel; reopen to verify original selections. Never Save access, Resend invite, Remove/Restore portal access.
paths.expected: Selection scope names the contact and projects; Cancel discards local draft; modal and picker keyboard handling work.

paths.entry: Brief actions > Copy link / Send Brief

paths.expected: Copy differs from sending; scope and recipient are explicit; blank required message disables Send; no access/status/message mutation.

paths.entry: Add/Replace media on an existing row
paths.actions: Open the four-command source submenu and inspect labels, order, keyboard and Escape only. Do not activate Upload file, Add from your Media, Stock footage search or Add link until that exact consumer callback has been verified to open a draft-only form. Current Storyboard library/stock callbacks immediately attach an image; native Add link prompt was not verified. No file/source/URL selection is authorised merely for inspection.
paths.expected: Four approved commands retained in order; submenu positioning and dismissal. Library/stock workflow outcomes and Add link prompt remain unverified, not inspected forms.
paths.status: Unverified action map; lead updates master coverage

paths.entry: Open review for frame 1
paths.actions: Open existing frame review; inspect unavailable-image treatment, Comments, drawing affordances and disabled unsupported attachment/recording controls. Open frame actions then Escape; Back. Do not Duplicate/Remove/Delete/Draw/Post.
paths.expected: Frame identity and existing media retained, unavailable image honest, actions readable/focus restored.

paths.entry: Transcript actions / per-clip actions / paragraph comment pin
paths.actions: Inspect collection filters; open header and clip actions then Escape. Tab to a paragraph comment pin and Enter/Space, observe whether comment or playback opens; do not post. paths.entry: Pre-production > Interview Questions > Add question / People > Add person / Locations > Add location
paths.actions: Use section navigation without Setup answers. Add question opens local draft, inspect blank Save disabled then Cancel. Add person picker may be opened and Add new contact form inspected, never choose existing person. Add location modal inspect and Cancel. Schedule existing shot Edit opens draft; Cancel. Do not Add shot, edit inline fields, captured/asked toggles, confirm readiness or Send.

paths.entry: Edit message
